name: redact_mark
description: Mark content for redaction (nothing is removed until redact_apply). One of: rect [x0, y0, x1, y1] (points from the top-left of the displayed page) with page; find (text, every match); pattern (phone, email, credit-card, ssn, date: every match, Acrobat's Search & Redact patterns); whole_pages: true. find, pattern and whole_pages work on pages (default all). overlay: text shown on the box once applied; fill: box colour (default black). Undoable.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers to search or mark (default: all).
